Priya: I'll draft the appendix with model, seq len, batch, and cost math. Keep it simple.
ops-bot: Reminder: partner legal approval needed for co-brand claims. Deadline 2026-05-07.
Sam: Action items: Priya 1 appendix; Eli 1 slide + speaker notes with conservative claim; Marta 1 blog draft; Sam 1 CRM tagging and report template. Sync Tuesday 9am.
